words.definition: a set of instructions for cooking a dish.

words.definition: to cook food in very hot water.

words.definition: to cook food in hot oil.
words.example: He fried the eggs for breakfast.

words.definition: to cook food in an oven, especially bread or cakes.
words.example: We baked a chocolate cake.

words.definition: to cook food in an oven with dry heat, usually meat or vegetables.
words.example: We roasted a chicken for dinner.

words.definition: to cut food into small pieces.

words.definition: to cut something into thin flat pieces.
words.example: Slice the bread before serving.

words.definition: to combine two or more things together.

words.definition: to try a small amount of food to check its flavor.

words.definition: having a very pleasant taste.

words.definition: recently made or picked, not old.

words.definition: having a strong, hot taste.

words.definition: having a sharp taste, like a lemon.
words.example: Lemons taste sour.

words.definition: having a taste like sugar.
words.example: The cake was very sweet.

words.definition: ready to eat, fully grown.
words.example: The bananas are not ripe yet.

words.definition: food that remains after a meal.
words.example: We ate the leftovers the next day.

words.definition: an amount of food for one person.
words.example: Can I have a small portion, please?

words.definition: food prepared in a particular way as part of a meal.
words.example: This is my favorite dish.

words.definition: the food eaten at a particular time, like breakfast or dinner.
words.example: We had a big meal together.

text: On Sunday, I decided to try a new recipe I found online. First, I checked I had all the ingredients: chicken, rice, vegetables, and some spices. I began by chopping an onion and a few vegetables into small pieces. Then I had to slice a ripe tomato and mix it with the other ingredients in a big pot. The recipe said to fry the chicken first, then boil it with rice for twenty minutes. For dessert, I decided to bake a cake instead of buying one. While the cake was in the oven, I roasted some potatoes as a side dish. When everything was ready, I had to taste the food before serving it — it was a little too spicy for me, so I added some sugar to balance the sour and sweet flavors. The final meal was absolutely delicious! I made too much food, so I had a lot of leftovers for the next day. I gave my neighbor a portion too, and she loved it. Cooking a fresh, homemade dish takes time, but it always tastes better than fast food.
